body: Mixed messages, missing context, or a story that keeps changing can make you question what you actually know. When Mercury squares Neptune, thought and imagination blur together, making assumptions, rumors, and emotionally satisfying explanations much easier to mistake for facts. If one piece of information would materially change your decision, verify that piece before you move. You do not need to solve every uncertainty at once. Leave the blank space blank until you have enough reality to fill it in.
